frequency_question: How often do major agency rulemakings successfully traverse administrative procedure and complete final promulgation within a standard ~315-day timeframe once proposed?
membership_rule: Includes economically significant rules proposed and finalized within a single Presidential administration's first 2 years; excludes sub-regulatory guidance and emergency interim rules without comment periods.

cases.name: Bush OSHA Ergonomics Rule Reversal (Congressional Review Act)
Obama EPA Mercury and Air Toxics Standards
Trump EPA Clean Power Plan Repeal
Biden EPA Light-Duty Vehicle Emissions Standards

coverage_note: 6 named cases; representative of high-salience executive rulemakings facing intense procedural and legal friction.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list all thousands of routine rules, but specifically targets high-friction, highly contested economic regulations analogous in scale.
skeleton: Total major contentious rules initiated in first 2 years divided by those successfully reaching final publication without indefinite injunction halting promulgation.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 6 comparable major contested structural rules successfully finalized within the target window.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act baselines remain stable until statutory reform or profound structural shift in judicial review doctrine occurs.
